decaying_aftermath.procedure.cancel: Esc: leave; used material is not restored
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.wrap: Grab the roll and wind clockwise. Multiple layers provide gradual bleed care. Keep winding; the percentage is remaining material.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.syrin: LMB: align and insert the needle. Hold RMB for the plunger, then withdraw straight.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.potio: LMB: bring the bottle to the wound. Mouse wheel: tilt; keep the pouring angle steady.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.splin: Align the splint with both marks. Mouse wheel: rotate. Release to fit.
Thread each strap to the right, then pull it left to tension. Stay on the rail.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.tourn: Place the tourniquet between the marks, then release.
Thread the strap to the right, then grasp the windlass and turn it clockwise three times.
decaying_aftermath.thought.supply_space: Need room for the unused items.
